time.desc: The server manufacturer submitted overdue annual and quarterly reports to the regulatory agency, regained compliance with the exchange's listing requirements, and the delisting crisis was lifted.
Company executives accurately reduced their holdings and cashed out during the sensitive period of financial reporting, raising questions about insider trading.
The company appoints new independent directors and general counsel to strengthen corporate governance structure
The company disclosed a decline in quarterly performance, with gross profit margin and net profit shrinking significantly, and lowered its full-year revenue forecast.
The company disclosed that there are major flaws in the internal control of financial reporting, and the effectiveness of rectification is doubtful
The company's co-founder was arrested on suspicion of smuggling high-end chips to certain countries and faces multiple federal criminal charges.
The former executive involved resigned as a director, and the company appointed an acting chief compliance officer and separated the compliance and financial functions.
The independent directors launched an independent investigation into employees suspected of chip smuggling and hired external law firms and consultants.

The company officially disclosed the investigation structure, making it clear that it will be led by the lead independent director, assisted by the chairman of the audit committee, and report in coordination with the audit agency

The company disclosed its fiscal year results. Revenue doubled, net profit increased significantly year-on-year, but gross profit margin declined, confirming that the report does not need to be restated.
After Company A submitted its overdue financial report and lifted the risk of delisting, its stock price soared by more than 22% in after-hours trading.
Company A disclosed that its gross profit margin for the fiscal year fell from approximately 18% to approximately 13.8%, putting the quality of earnings under pressure.

After Company A completed the submission of all overdue documents, its stock price soared by more than 23% after the market closed. It plummeted by nearly 12% during the session as the delisting cutoff approached.
The CEO of Company A said that some customers have postponed platform decisions and deferred related orders to subsequent quarters.

Company A gave guidance on the range of net sales for the next quarter and stated that it has implemented the recommendations of the special committee and complied with all exchange reporting requirements.
